title: AliExpress Scraper Input
description: Search AliExpress by keyword, look up products and stores, or collect customer reviews across major shopper regions.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to collect. search: keyword results. byProduct: product lookup by ID or URL. byStore: store lookup. byReviews: customer reviews. byUrl: auto-detect from pasted AliExpress links.

searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)
searchQueries.description: One or more keywords, e.g. "phone case" or "wireless earbuds". Each query is scraped up to maxPages pages.

productIds.title: Product IDs or URLs (mode=byProduct or byReviews)
productIds.description: Numeric AliExpress product IDs or item URLs. Both 1005… and 3256… ID formats are accepted.

urls.title: AliExpress URLs (mode=byUrl)
urls.description: Any mix of search, item, store and review URLs. The mode is detected per URL.

region.title: Shopper region
region.description: Country used for prices, availability and the storefront locale. Global leaves the region to the requesting IP.

currency.title: Currency override
currency.description: Optional ISO-4217 currency. Leave blank to use the region's usual currency. The currency actually returned is recorded in every record.

language.title: Language
language.description: Storefront language and the language used to translate review text.

sortBy.title: Sort order (mode=search)
sortBy.description: How keyword results are ordered. AliExpress does not expose a newest sort.

priceMin.title: Minimum price
priceMin.description: Minimum price in the selected currency. 0 disables the lower bound.

priceMax.title: Maximum price
priceMax.description: Maximum price in the selected currency. 0 disables the upper bound.

ratingMin.title: Minimum rating
ratingMin.description: Minimum star rating from 0 to 5. Products without a rating are skipped when a threshold is set.

shipFrom.title: Ship from country
shipFrom.description: Only show items stocked in this country. Leave blank for any warehouse.

freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only
freeShippingOnly.description: Only show items advertised with free shipping.

fourStarPlus.title: 4 stars and up only
fourStarPlus.description: Only show items rated 4.0 or higher. The actor enforces the 4.0 threshold after AliExpress returns its filtered page.

includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored results
includeSponsored.description: Include promoted product cards; they are marked isSponsored in the output.

includeWelcomeGifts.title: Include welcome-gift cards
includeWelcomeGifts.description: Include $0.00 new-shopper gift cards; they are marked isWelcomeGift and have no normal price.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on records emitted by the run.

maxPages.title: Max search pages
maxPages.description: Maximum result pages per query (60 products per page, up to 60 pages).

includeReviews.title: Attach reviews
includeReviews.description: Fetch customer reviews for each product (slow and adds records to the product).

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Review cap per product when reviews are fetched. 0 uses the default of 20.

includeProductStats.title: Include review summary
includeProductStats.description: Add each product's average rating and total review count to review records.
